_help: Har app ke liye 3 cheez likho: name (naam), apk (direct apk link), banner (photo ka link). Naya app add karne ke liye neeche wala ek block copy karke apps ki list mein comma laga kar paste karo. description, version, icon optional hain. Is file ko GitHub repo (main branch) mein apps.json naam se rakho - rebuild nahi chahiye.
